may_also_order.plain_name: Shot of anti-inflammatory and numbing medicine
may_also_order.why: It can calm the pain for a while so you can do your exercises. Guidelines say a single shot can be considered for short-term relief.

may_also_order.plain_name: Live sound-wave picture of the tendons
may_also_order.why: If the X-ray looks normal and the pain continues, this shows whether a tendon is torn and how big the tear is.

may_also_order.plain_name: Detailed scan of tendons & cartilage
may_also_order.why: If the X-ray looks normal and the pain continues, this shows tendon tears and cartilage damage in detail.

may_also_order.plain_name: Detailed scan with dye in the joint
may_also_order.why: The dye seeps into small tears, so it shows damage to the cartilage rim around the socket (the labrum) better. It's used when clicking comes with catching or a slipping feeling.
